subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` become a hard-capped public CLI input, and if so is 8 MiB the supported upgrade-compatible limit?
rationale: The branch intentionally converts a formerly unbounded user-supplied input into a hard failure path; source and the related metadata-reader precedent do not establish the acceptable batch-file limit or upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve a documented 8 MiB contract
options.body: Keep the bounded reader, state that 8 MiB is the supported maximum, and add focused boundary coverage before merge.

options.title: Choose a different compatible limit
options.body: Retain the bounded-reader approach but set a limit justified by expected batch-file usage and test the resulting contract.

options.title: Defer the cap
options.body: Keep the existing behavior until maintainers select a supported limit and failure policy for existing automation.

recommendation.title: Approve a documented 8 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Keep the bounded reader, state that 8 MiB is the supported maximum, and add focused boundary coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related merged bounded-read implementation and can provide the strongest available context on the shared primitive, although a repository decision-maker must approve the public CLI contract.
